name: Lavant
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy hamlet in the Drautal valley, featuring rustic farms and untouched nature.
beschreibung:
Overview

Lavant is a sun-blessed rural municipality in East Tyrol within the Lienz district, picturesquely situated at an altitude of 675 metres along the southeastern edge of the wide Lienz basin. Home to roughly 350 residents, the peaceful settlement nestles beneath the sheer limestone cliffs of the Lienz Dolomites and the historic hill of the Lavanter Kirchbichl. Despite its modest size, Lavant holds a prestigious place in Tyrol's cultural and sporting landscape: alongside one of the most significant early Christian archaeological excavations in the Eastern Alps, it hosts the 36-hole championship Dolomitengolf Osttirol resort, attracting golf aficionados, culture seekers, hikers, and alpine cyclists.

History

The commanding limestone hill of the Kirchbichl was fortified as early as prehistoric times, evolving during late antiquity into a crucial fortified hilltop settlement. Following the decline of the nearby Roman city of Aguntum in the 5th century AD, Lavant became a secure refuge and an early Christian episcopal seat. Extensive excavations have unearthed the remnants of a monumental early Christian cathedral dating from the 4th to the 6th century, complete with baptisteries and fortification walls. During the Middle Ages, the prominent Gothic pilgrimage church of the Visitation of Mary was erected atop the hill, complemented by the village parish church of Saint Ulrich below. This layered heritage renders Lavant an invaluable sanctuary of Tyrolean history.

Getting There

Lavant is easily reached via East Tyrol's primary road network. Motorists travel from Lienz along the B100 Drautal road toward Carinthia, branching off onto the well-signposted L318 regional road after approximately eight kilometres. Approaching from the south, access is via the B110 Plöckenpass road and the Gailtal. Rail passengers arrive at Lienz main station, a key transportation hub served by ÖBB regional trains, where local VVT buses provide direct, reliable connections to Lavant and the golf resort. Cyclists can also reach the village conveniently via the long-distance Drau Cycle Path (R1).

Tips

Exploring the open-air archaeological park on the Kirchbichl and visiting the Gothic pilgrimage church of the Visitation is a must, offering rewarding insights into late Roman antiquity alongside sweeping panoramas across the Lienz Valley. Golfers will appreciate the 36-hole championship facility at Dolomitengolf Osttirol, set against the dramatic limestone backdrop of the Lienz Dolomites. Hikers can follow the scenic nature trail to the roaring Frauenbach Waterfall, while alpine mountaineers will find Lavant an ideal base for ascending towards iconic mountain huts like the Dolomitenhütte and Karlsbader Hütte.
